india.one_line: Indian courts examine AI copyright, telecom firms expand data infrastructure, and startups secure new funding.

themes.title: Indian companies navigate AI investments and layoffs
themes.text: Bharti Airtel committed ₹1,200 crore for Assam data centres, Dunzo cofounder's startup M raised $9 million, Swiggy Instamart laid off 340 employees during an AI shift, and Jio Platforms temporarily launched JioAstro.

stories.headline: Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres
Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M raises $9 Mn
Swiggy Instamart lays off 340 employees amid AI push and inventory shift
Jio Platforms launches and takes down AI astrology platform JioAstro

themes.title: Policy debates and budget consultations focus on AI
themes.text: The Delhi High Court is examining whether AI can be a legal author, while the Finance Minister consulted Gen Z on AI and jobs for the upcoming budget.

stories.headline: Delhi High Court to examine if AI can be author under copyright law
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman holds first Gen Z pre-budget meeting
